findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0364: Exported And Unprotected Activities That Expose Sensitive Functionality
findings.explanation:
The exported StartupActivity reads an Intent from its own extras and starts it if it targets the app's package, so any app can open non-exported activities with attacker-chosen extras (after the PIN gate, or directly when no PIN is set). ModernMain and GiftBoxRootActivity are behind the global PIN gate and accept only a boolean argument. Ward's analyzer said: Exported activities without a permission. Ward lists them; check whether each one exposes sensitive functionality or trusts its intent's data.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/activity/StartupActivity.kt:402: Caller-supplied Intent is taken from the exported activity's extras.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/activity/StartupActivity.kt:413: The redirected intent is launched with the app's identity, reaching non-exported activities.
mbw/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:96: activity .activity.StartupActivity; exported: yes (android:exported is set); deep link schemes: bitcoin, bitid, btcpop, mycelium, http
mbw/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:177: activity .activity.modern.ModernMain; exported: yes (android:exported is set)
mbw/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:347: activity com.mycelium.giftbox.GiftBoxRootActivity; exported: yes (android:exported is set)

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0327: References to APIs for Event-Bound Biometric Authentication
findings.explanation:
Biometric unlock (used in place of the wallet PIN) calls BiometricPrompt.authenticate without a CryptoObject and relies on the success callback; no Keystore key with setUserAuthenticationRequired exists.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/activity/util/FingerprintHandler.kt:23: authenticate() called with PromptInfo only, no CryptoObject.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0329: References to APIs Enforcing Authentication without Explicit User Action
findings.explanation:
The biometric prompt that replaces PIN entry for sensitive wallet actions sets setConfirmationRequired(false).
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/activity/util/FingerprintHandler.kt:25: Explicit confirmation disabled.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0337: References to Object Deserialization of Untrusted Data
findings.explanation:
The exported StartupActivity deserializes a Parcelable Intent from untrusted extras and acts on it with only a package-name check.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/activity/StartupActivity.kt:402: Untrusted Intent extra deserialized in an exported activity.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0393: Use of Unverified App Links
findings.explanation:
StartupActivity declares an http deep link for wallet.mycelium.com without android:autoVerify="true", so any app can claim it.
mbw/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:174: http scheme deep link in an intent-filter without autoVerify.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0309: References to Reused Initialization Vectors in Symmetric Encryption
findings.explanation:
The key cipher that encrypts seeds and private keys starts CBC chaining from an all-zero IV on every encryption, so the IV is reused for every message under the same key.
walletcore/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wapi/wallet/AesKeyCipher.java:156: Fixed zero IV for every encryption.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0312: References to Explicit Security Provider in Cryptographic APIs
findings.explanation:
A getInstance call names the BouncyCastle provider explicitly.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/external/changelly/ChangellyHeaderInterceptor.kt:96: Signature.getInstance with explicit "BC" provider.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0208: Insufficient Key Sizes
findings.explanation:
Wallet secrets are encrypted with AES-128 keys (16-byte key length constant, first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of the PIN/password), which the test text calls insufficient.
walletcore/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wapi/wallet/AesKeyCipher.java:33: AES key length fixed at 128 bits for the key cipher protecting seeds and private keys.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0212: Use of Hardcoded Cryptographic Keys in Code
findings.explanation:
Hardcoded keys are used in security-sensitive contexts: the AES key that encrypts the wallet master seed and private keys (defaultKeyCipher) is a constant in code, and an RSA private key that signs Changelly API requests is embedded in the app.
walletcore/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wapi/wallet/AesKeyCipher.java:35: The default key cipher uses a constant AES key compiled into the app.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/activity/StartupActivity.kt:262: The master seed is stored encrypted with that hardcoded default key cipher.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/external/changelly/ChangellyHeaderInterceptor.kt:126: An RSA private key (PKCS#8) used to sign exchange API requests is hardcoded.
walletcore/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wapi/wallet/ConfigObfuscation.kt:24: The same constant AES key protects third-party API keys in config.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0233: Hardcoded HTTP URLs
findings.explanation:
The testnet flavor's release build sends the energy-service API calls (with a partner API key) to a plain-http IP address, and NSC permits cleartext for it; colu test and media-dev are also http.
mbw/build.gradle:366: Release EnergyServiceUrl is plain http.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0235: Android App Configurations Allowing Cleartext Traffic
findings.explanation:
The network security config sets cleartextTrafficPermitted="true" in a domain-config covering several production and partner domains. Ward's analyzer said: The base cleartext default depends on targetSdk, which Ward couldn't resolve.
mbw/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml:3: domain-config allows cleartext HTTP.
mbw/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:58: networkSecurityConfig @xml/network_security_config

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0282: Unsafe Custom Trust Evaluation
findings.explanation:
configureSSLSocket installs a TrustManager with an empty checkServerTrusted on Android 7.0/7.1 (minSdk 24), used for gift box and exchange clients; BitID can switch to a trust-all socket factory.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/ext.kt:85: checkServerTrusted accepts every certificate on API 24-25.
bitlib/src/main/java/com/mrd/bitlib/util/SslUtils.java:219: Trust-all TrustManager behind SSL_SOCKET_FACTORY_ACCEPT_ALL.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/bitid/BitIdAuthenticator.java:141: BitID authentication can run over the trust-all socket factory.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0283: Incorrect Implementation of Server Hostname Verification
findings.explanation:
A HostnameVerifier that always returns true is used for the WAPI endpoints (pinned by cert thumbprint) and for BitID when the user skips SSL checks.
bitlib/src/main/java/com/mrd/bitlib/util/SslUtils.java:207: verify() unconditionally returns true.
mbwlib/src/main/java/com/mycelium/net/HttpsEndpoint.java:27: Accept-all hostname verifier set on the HTTPS endpoint client.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0381: References to Insecure PendingIntent Creation
findings.explanation:
Most PendingIntents are immutable and explicit (USB permission ones are FLAG_MUTABLE as the system requires, with setPackage), but the push notification PendingIntent wraps an implicit ACTION_VIEW base intent built from a server-supplied link.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/lt/notification/FcmListenerService.kt:90: PendingIntent base intent is implicit (no component set).

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0315: Sensitive Data Exposed via Notifications
findings.explanation:
A notification shows the amount of coins received (financial data) on the lock screen with default visibility; minSdk is 24, so no notification permission gate applies on older devices.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/activity/receive/ReceiveCoinsModel.kt:182: Received amount is put in the notification text.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0316: App Exposing User Authentication Data in Text Input Fields
findings.explanation:
The field for the backup decryption password (which unlocks exported private keys) uses textVisiblePassword, so the access code is shown unmasked.
mbw/src/main/res/layout/export_decrypt_private_key_activity.xml:41: Backup password EditText is a visible-password field (unmasked).

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0254: Dangerous App Permissions
findings.explanation:
CAMERA (QR scanning) and ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION (local trader) have features behind them, but WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is declared while the code never writes to external storage. Ward's analyzer said: Dangerous (runtime) permissions requested. Check that each is needed for a feature, and that a weaker one (coarse instead of fine location, foreground instead of background) would not do.
mbw/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:13: Unneeded dangerous storage permission.
mbw/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:10: android.permission.CAMERA
mbw/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:11: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
mbw/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:13: android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE

findings.title: MASWE-0072: Inadequate Privacy Policy
findings.explanation:
A privacy policy link or text is in the app. Ward doesn't read the policy: check that it matches what the app collects and the Data safety answers.
mbw/src/main/res/layout/activity_set_segwit_change.xml:52: privacy policy
mbw/src/main/res/values-fil/strings.xml:322: privacy policy
mbw/src/main/res/values-in/strings.xml:355: privacy policy
mbw/src/main/res/values-iw/strings.xml:488: privacy policy
mbw/src/main/res/values/strings.xml:249: privacy policy

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0265: References to StrictMode APIs
findings.explanation:
StrictMode APIs are referenced in release code (thread policy relaxed around disk reads); the VmPolicy with penaltyLog is debug-only.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/MbwManager.java:275: StrictMode used unconditionally.

findings.title: MASWE-0004: Sensitive Data Hardcoded in the App Package
findings.explanation:
Secrets are hardcoded in the app package: an RSA private key for the exchange API and partner API keys for the TRON energy service in build config fields.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/external/changelly/ChangellyHeaderInterceptor.kt:126: Hardcoded RSA private key for the exchange API.
mbw/build.gradle:330: Partner API key for the energy service compiled into the release build.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0231: References to Logging APIs
findings.explanation:
Logging calls are not stripped in release (no ProGuard assumenosideeffects, minify off) and log transaction contents and push payloads.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/extsig/common/ExternalSignatureDeviceManager.kt:157: The full unsigned transaction (addresses, amounts) is written to logcat.
mbw/src/main/java/com/mycelium/wallet/lt/notification/FcmListenerService.kt:48: The full FCM data payload (trade notifications) is logged.
